title: Dynamic Detail Forms
author: Tom Fitch, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Dynamically generated HTML detail forms from table/field metadata

historical_commentary.text: This note builds dynamic record-entry forms by generating raw HTML/CSS/JavaScript on the fly and rendering it inside a classic 4D Web Area, using WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION to shuttle field values between JavaScript and 4D method code — a workaround necessitated by the lack of any native dynamic-form or object-based UI layer in 4D v11. That whole approach is functionally obsolete today: 4D now has ORDA (v16 R5+, 2017) for introspecting table/field metadata and entities without hand-rolled pointer-and-array bookkeeping, plus 4D Write Pro and modern form objects (and eventually 4D for iOS/webforms) for building UI dynamically without hosting a hand-authored HTML mini-application inside a Web Area. The specific component (raw HTML generation + WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION plumbing) would not be how a developer would tackle this problem today.
related_updates: ORDA (4D v16 R5+, 2017) provides native metadata introspection (dataclass/attribute enumeration) instead of manual Field()/Table() pointer walking
4D form objects and dynamic form generation APIs (form editor scripting, list forms) have matured well beyond hosting a hand-built HTML app in a Web Area
4D Write Pro / modern web project mode reduce the need for this kind of raw-HTML Web-Area workaround
